caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of fabric featuring a repeating pattern in red and beige tones. The pattern is composed of large flowers and leafy plants distributed throughout the composition, with several birds, possibly cranes or herons, prominently positioned among the foliage. The birds have long necks and legs and are shown standing on or near rocks and amidst a variety of detailed floral arrangements, including large blossoms and layered leaves. Some birds are depicted with wings outstretched while others are perched in a more relaxed pose. The background is beige, and the intricate red designs cover nearly the entire area of the fabric, creating a dense and detailed composition. The edges of the fabric section are uneven, and the fabric itself is presented against a plain, off-white background with no additional elements visible around the textile.
title: Printed Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
